title: Quiet system log
line: Stops steamos-manager filling the system log with split-lock lines, so older logs aren't wiped.
symptom: steamos-manager hands every split-lock hit to a crash reporter Bazzite doesn't have; each hit and each failure is logged (about 70,000 lines in five minutes on a Claw 8 EX, 14 % of a CPU core), so the capped journal loses every earlier boot within minutes.
why: Any handheld with steamos-manager but without Valve's steamos-log-submitter (Bazzite); the fix checks for both, so it is offered everywhere.
risk_note: One systemd drop-in; only the log lines of steamos-manager's crash-report forwarding go. Everything else it logs stays.

changes.detail: systemd reloads its units and restarts steamos-manager if it runs.

undo: Deletes the drop-in, reloads systemd and restarts steamos-manager.
bazzite: Not fixed: Bazzite ships steamos-manager without steamos-log-submitter.
steamos: Not needed: SteamOS has steamos-log-submitter, which takes the hits.
sources: ClawDeck py_modules/clawdeck/quietlog.py and docs/HARDWARE-FINDINGS.md (measured on a Claw 8 EX, 2026-11-04)

probe.what: Looks for another steamos-manager drop-in (not GameCove's) that already turns the forwarding module's log off; the fix is not needed where steamos-log-submitter is installed.

watch.note: steamos-manager's log-submitter forwarding: a change that skips it without the reporter makes this fix unnecessary.
Bazzite's own systemd units: a drop-in for steamos-manager there would make this os-fixed.
